lines.1: 「Everyone, your final exams are finally upon us. Please fight with everything you have.」
lines.2: 「...And if your grades should prove disappointing...」
lines.3: 「Oh, how terrifying. I simply cannot bring myself to say it.」
lines.4: 「Well, you can kiss summer vacation goodbye. And if you refuse to accept that, you're expelled.」
lines.6: After our homeroom teacher had thoroughly terrorized us like that--
lines.8: 「...Damn it. In my fantasies I'm a superman who finishes a test like this in one minute and starts breakdancing on top of the desk. Reality is always so cruel...」
lines.9: 「Well, guess this is about what I expected... Man. Am I looking at remedial classes?」
lines.10: 「Brains don't matter. Instinct does! I'll score points with pure instinct!」
lines.11: My childhood friends were having a pretty rough time.
lines.13: 「Let's see, this goes here... This one's pretty easy.」
lines.14: The high-achieving group looked as comfortable as ever.
lines.16: 「Oh... That notebook is really paying off.」
lines.17: Its predictions were hitting pretty often.
lines.18: I had that feeling you get when a test is going well.
lines.23: 「--Yeah, that notebook helped me a lot.」
lines.24: 「It's not like every prediction was right, though.」
lines.25: 「Of course not. It only analyzes patterns. What matters in the end is how much work you normally put in.」
lines.27: 「...Still, at this rate I think I can make it through finals.」
lines.28: 「Don't let your guard down. They've only just started.」
lines.29: I couldn't tell whether she was scolding me or cheering me on.
